profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at The Home Depot
profile.summary: I'm a Software Engineer blurring the line between creativity and technology. I've always been excited about the fast-paced culture of the tech industry and how I can join a pioneering team to craft something that people can interact with.

positions.title: Freelance Full-Stack Web Developer & Student
positions.description: A 12 week full-immersive development program focused on building the fundamentals skills to become a full stack developer. Learned and applied best practices for product and full stack development. Topics covered include: HTML | CSS | React.js | Ruby/on Rails | Git/GitHub | jQuery | JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | OOP | MongoDb | SQL/PostgreSQL | Agile Practices.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Responsible for the company’s overall vision and strategy as well as day-to-day operations.
Distribute and utilize materials, machines and tools while maintaining quality control.
Monitor all phases of construction projects including creating a budget, scheduling construction and
overseeing field operations.

positions.title: Future Experiences Strategist
positions.description:
Provided insights on emerging trends for ongoing client innovation reports for national brands.
Assisted in the production of the quarterly/yearly trends reports for client and internal distribution.
Worked with cross-functional teams to identify and compile key category and out-of-category best in-class examples of innovation, programs and trends on an ongoing basis.

positions.title: Innovation and Emerging Media Intern
positions.description:
Assisted IEM team with various client projects and recurring deliverables.
Monitored client competitive landscape in digital advertising and emerging technologies.
Assisted with proofreading and QA on daily/weekly Pulse deliverables.

positions.title: Sales Representative
positions.description:
Catered to clientele and assisted in finding desired products.
Effectively conducted sales that improved daily profits.

positions.title: English Language Instructor
positions.description:
Taught English as a second language to eight elementary coeducational institutions.
Designed creative and dynamic curricula utilizing outcome-based education.
Organized a core program for SMOE's summer and winter English camps.
Effectively altered lessons to accommodate different English speaking and listening levels.

educations.schoolName: University of Georgia - Terry College of Business
